# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers we clean forms.py first and then add classes incrementally one by one.
- For all files to be created and existing, write code line by line, not just copy and paste the entire code.
- All code should be written in a way that is easy to read and understand, with clear comments explaining the purpose of each section.
- Do not hardcode real or real-looking secrets (e.g., DB passwords) as fallback defaults in settings files or .env.example; use empty/placeholder values instead and require them via the actual .env file.
